reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Remove `.status.crossplane.connectionDetails` from modern XR schema by @jbw976 in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6655", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The `.status.crossplane.connectionDetails` field is no longer recognized in modern XR schema and will be ignored.
